set.body:
Outcome: ordinary paired runs accept the approved existing checked policy choices without hidden level/order substitutions.
Scope: MappingPipeline config/execute/lexical/batchOnnx, MappingSettings, caption/ONNX registration seams and consumed codecs per D.
Acceptance: a nonzero-level complete reference cut is selected before nomination/pricing; each applicable lexical/caption/ONNX entry executes it or returns an explicit capability refusal rather than silently substituting level zero. Selected reconstruction model, grouping and order are content-bound in identities/receipts. Default configuration preserves D's compatibility promise. A fixture whose result discriminates ordering policies demonstrates executed choice; changing reconstruction assumptions leaves reference evidence/profile/output invariant on matched input. Refuse foreign universe/grouping/registration, unsupported weight/profile combinations and non-finite invalid policies. Newly requested fill is outside scope. Extend B summaries for the selected choices.
Evidence: MappingPipelineSuite, MappingSettingsSuite, ReconstructionPolicySuite, relevant registration and external consumer tests plus independent readback. Preserve original registration/provider-origin safeguards.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
